description:
Flag content for moderation review. Authentication is required.

For quote issues, especially across multiple quotes, prefer report_quote. Use this tool for originator, source, and sighting flags. Provide exactly ONE entity identifier.

Examples:
- `flag_content(flag_type="misattributed", reason="Quote is by Mark Twain", quote_ref="abc123")` - report wrong attribution
- `flag_content(flag_type="broken_link", reason="404 error", sighting_id=12345)` - report dead link

evidence_url.description: URL supporting the flag (e.g., QuoteInvestigator link)

flag_type.description: Type of flag: spam (advertising/promotional), misattributed (wrong author), typo (text error), nested (quote within quote), broken_link (dead URL)

name: flag_content
title: Flag content for moderation
